esbuild, patch html-to-image font-size reducer

Switch the build from plain tsc (which emits per-file .js with bare
'html-to-image' import specifiers) to tsc --emitDeclarationOnly +
esbuild --bundle. The output is a single self-contained dist/index.js
(102 KB ESM) with html-to-image fully inlined — no importmap, no
runtime dependency resolution, no CDN needed.

html-to-image is moved from dependencies to devDependencies since
consumers get the bundled output with no transitive deps.

Also sets up patch-package to strip the font-size reducer from
html-to-image's cloneCSSStyle function. The reducer did
Math.floor(fontSize) - 0.1 on every element, turning 22px into
21.9px in the captured SVG foreignObject. The patch removes it from
all three build outputs (es/, lib/, dist/) and is auto-applied on
every npm install via a postinstall script." class="Link--secondary" href="/ybouane/liquidglass/commit/c5dc3087bdfab3b0835b29816b700a2421a6f8c7">Bundle dist with esbuild, patch html-to-image font-size with esbuild, patch html-to-image font-size reducer

Switch the build from plain tsc (which emits per-file .js with bare
'html-to-image' import specifiers) to tsc --emitDeclarationOnly +
esbuild --bundle. The output is a single self-contained dist/index.js
(102 KB ESM) with html-to-image fully inlined — no importmap, no
runtime dependency resolution, no CDN needed.

html-to-image is moved from dependencies to devDependencies since
consumers get the bundled output with no transitive deps.

Also sets up patch-package to strip the font-size reducer from
html-to-image's cloneCSSStyle function. The reducer did
Math.floor(fontSize) - 0.1 on every element, turning 22px into
21.9px in the captured SVG foreignObject. The patch removes it from
all three build outputs (es/, lib/, dist/) and is auto-applied on
every npm install via a postinstall script." class="Link--secondary" href="/ybouane/liquidglass/commit/c5dc3087bdfab3b0835b29816b700a2421a6f8c7">Bundle dist with esbuild, patch html-to-image font-size <div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">How It Works</h2><a id="user-content-how-it-works" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: How It Works" href="#how-it-works"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ol dir="auto">
<li><strong>Non-glass children of the root</strong> are rasterised onto a hidden canvas using <code>html-to-image</code> (which clones the subtree, inlines computed styles, and renders via SVG <code>foreignObject</code>). Static children are captured once and cached; children with <code>data-dynamic</code> (or any <code><video></code>) are re-captured every frame.</li>
<li><strong><code><img></code>, <code><canvas></code>, and <code><video></code></strong> are drawn directly via <code>ctx.drawImage</code> (faster than <code>html-to-image</code>, and the only way to capture live video frames).</li>
<li><strong>Glass elements</strong> receive an injected child <code><canvas></code> that displays the WebGL output. For each glass element, the renderer crops the scene at the panel's location, runs an optional Gaussian blur, then runs a fragment shader that applies refraction, chromatic aberration, Fresnel reflection, multi-light specular highlights, an inner-stroke rim, and a drop shadow.</li>
<li><strong>Layered compositing</strong> writes each rendered glass canvas back to the compositing canvas before the next glass element runs, so a glass element above another sees the lower one in its refraction.</li>
</ol>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">API</h2><a id="user-content-api" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: API" href="#api"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto"><code>LiquidGlass.init(options)</code></h3><a id="user-content-liquidglassinitoptions" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: LiquidGlass.init(options)" href="#liquidglassinitoptions"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Async — creates and starts a LiquidGlass instance. Resolves once the page's webfonts have been pre-fetched and every glass element's content has been pre-captured.</p>
<markdown-accessiblity-table data-catalyst=""><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Option</th>
<th>Type</th>
<th>Default</th>
<th>Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>root</code></td>
<td><code>HTMLElement</code></td>
<td><em>(required)</em></td>
<td>The container element. Glass elements must be <strong>direct children</strong> of this element.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>glassElements</code></td>
<td><code>NodeList | HTMLElement[]</code></td>
<td><code>[]</code></td>
<td>Elements to apply the glass effect to.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>defaults</code></td>
<td><code>Partial<GlassConfig></code></td>
<td><code>{}</code></td>
<td>Override the default per-element configuration values for this instance.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></markdown-accessiblity-table>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Returns</strong> a <code>Promise<LiquidGlass></code> resolving to the instance, which exposes:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>.fps: number</code> — current measured frames-per-second (updated once per second).</li>
<li><code>.destroy(): void</code> — stop the render loop, remove injected canvases, restore mutated inline styles, and free WebGL resources.</li>
<li><code>.markChanged(element?: HTMLElement): void</code> — manually flag content the library can't observe on its own (see below).</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">The library also exports:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>invalidateFontEmbedCache(): void</code> — call after dynamically loading new font stylesheets so the next <code>init()</code> rebuilds the embedded font cache.</li>
</ul>

<p dir="auto"><code>data-dynamic</code> elements are treated as <strong>always dirty by definition</strong> — the library re-rasterises them every frame and re-runs the shader for every glass that overlaps them. Use it sparingly: it's the only thing on the page that defeats the per-element dirty-tracking optimisation.</p>
<p dir="auto"><code><video></code> elements are auto-detected as dynamic — you don't need to add <code>data-dynamic</code> to them.</p>
<p dir="auto">For one-shot updates that don't happen every frame, prefer <code>instance.markChanged()</code> (see below) — it costs nothing on idle frames.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto"><code>data-config</code></h3><a id="user-content-data-config" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: data-config" href="#data-config"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">JSON string of per-element configuration options (see the table above). Must decode to an object; invalid JSON or non-object values are ignored with a console warning.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Manually invalidating content: <code>instance.markChanged()</code></h2><a id="user-content-manually-invalidating-content-instancemarkchanged" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Manually invalidating content: instance.markChanged()" href="#manually-invalidating-content-instancemarkchanged"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The library auto-detects most things that affect the glass: DOM mutations inside glass subtrees, <code>data-config</code> changes, layout shifts, drag, hover/press, window resize, async capture cache landings, and <code>data-dynamic</code> / <code><video></code> elements (which are treated as <strong>always dirty by definition</strong> and re-rendered every frame).</p>
<p dir="auto">What it cannot detect:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>A <code><canvas></code> whose pixels you just updated via <code>getContext('2d')</code> / WebGL.</li>
<li>An <code><img></code> whose <code>src</code> you just swapped via JS.</li>
<li>A wrapper whose CSS <code>background-image</code> or other paint property you just updated.</li>
<li>Anything else that changes visually without firing a DOM mutation the library is watching.</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">For these cases, call:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-js notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">const</span> <span class="pl-s1">instance</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-k">await</span> <span class="pl-v">LiquidGlass</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">init</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">{</span> root<span class="pl-kos">,</span> glassElements <span class="pl-kos">}</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

<span class="pl-c">// You just repainted a wrapper — only glasses overlapping it will re-render.</span>
<span class="pl-s1">instance</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">markChanged</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-s1">myCanvasElement</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span>

<span class="pl-c">// Or invalidate everything on this instance:</span>
<span class="pl-s1">instance</span><span class="pl-kos">.</span><span class="pl-en">markChanged</span><span class="pl-kos">(</span><span class="pl-kos">)</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

// You just repainted a wrapper — only glasses overlapping it will re-render.
instance.markChanged(myCanvasElement);

// Or invalidate everything on this instance:

<p dir="auto"><code>markChanged(element)</code> walks every glass on the instance, finds the ones whose sample rect intersects the element's bounding rect, and marks just those for a re-render on the next frame. Glasses that don't overlap the element keep their cached output and skip the WebGL pipeline entirely.</p>
<p dir="auto"><code>markChanged()</code> with no argument flags every glass — useful as a "I don't know what changed but please redraw" escape hatch.</p>
<p dir="auto">For elements with <code>data-dynamic</code>, calling <code>markChanged</code> is harmless but unnecessary — the library already treats them as dirty every frame.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Stacking & Z-Index</h2><a id="user-content-stacking--z-index" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Stacking & Z-Index" href="#stacking--z-index"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The library re-implements the CSS stacking-context spec to decide painting order on the compositing canvas. It recognises the following stacking-context triggers on direct children of the root:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Non-static <code>position</code> (with z-index)</li>
<li>Grid/flex item with explicit <code>z-index</code></li>
<li><code>opacity < 1</code></li>
<li><code>transform</code>, <code>filter</code>, <code>perspective</code>, <code>clip-path</code>, <code>mix-blend-mode</code>, <code>isolation</code>, <code>backdrop-filter</code>, <code>mask-image</code>, <code>contain: layout|paint|strict|content</code></li>
<li><code>will-change</code> listing any of the above properties</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">If you put an overlay above a background image and the glass shows the bg but not the overlay, you've hit a missing trigger — file an issue with the property name.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Limitations & Gotchas</h2><a id="user-content-limitations--gotchas" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Limitations & Gotchas" href="#limitations--gotchas"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Structural</h3><a id="user-content-structural" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Structural" href="#structural"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Glass elements must be direct children of the root.</strong> Nested glass is rejected at init with a console warning. If you need glass inside a wrapper, give the wrapper its own <code>LiquidGlass.init()</code> call.</li>
<li><strong>The root itself is never captured.</strong> The shader samples the root's <em>children</em>, so any background image, padding, or border on the root is invisible to the glass effect. Put backgrounds in a sibling element <em>inside</em> the root.</li>
<li><strong>A <code><canvas></code> is injected as the glass element's first child</strong> for shader output. Avoid <code>:first-child</code> selectors on glass elements.</li>
<li><strong>Multiple LiquidGlass roots cannot share refraction.</strong> A glass element in one root cannot see what another root's glass elements are rendering — they each have their own compositing canvas.</li>
<li><strong>The shadow halo extends beyond the glass element.</strong> The injected canvas overflows its parent's box and will be clipped by any ancestor with <code>overflow: hidden</code>.</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Performance</h3><a id="user-content-performance" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Performance" href="#performance"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Capturing DOM into a canvas is expensive.</strong> Every non-glass wrapper is rasterised via <code>html-to-image</code> (style inlining + SVG-foreignObject decode). Keep wrappers small and shallow.</li>
<li><strong><code>data-dynamic</code> re-captures every frame.</strong> Use it sparingly — only for content that actually changes.</li>
<li><strong>Each LiquidGlass instance opens its own WebGL context.</strong> Browsers cap concurrent contexts (typically 16 system-wide); don't spawn dozens.</li>
<li><strong>Window resize re-captures everything.</strong> Don't drive layout in a tight resize loop.</li>
<li><strong>The render loop short-circuits when nothing is dirty</strong> — a static page with no <code><video></code> and no <code>data-dynamic</code> content does almost no work per frame.</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Text & fonts</h3><a id="user-content-text--fonts" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Text & fonts" href="#text--fonts"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Webfonts must be loaded before <code>init()</code></strong> and served with CORS-friendly headers. Google Fonts, jsdelivr, and unpkg work out of the box. Webfonts loaded after init will fall back to system fonts inside captured rasters. Call <code>invalidateFontEmbedCache()</code> then re-init if you load fonts dynamically.</li>
<li><strong>Cross-origin <code><img></code> elements need <code>crossorigin="anonymous"</code>.</strong> Tainted canvases break texture upload and disable the glass effect for the entire root.</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">API</h3><a id="user-content-api-1" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: API" href="#api-1"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong><code>LiquidGlass.init()</code> is async.</strong> It resolves only after the font CSS prefetch, glass content pre-capture, and static-content pre-warm have all completed (typically 100–500 ms on a fresh page).</li>
<li><strong><code>data-dynamic</code> only catches direct children of the root.</strong> Live content nested inside a wrapper that lacks <code>data-dynamic</code> will not trigger re-captures.</li>
<li><strong><code>destroy()</code> does not restore an element's original <code>position: static</code></strong> if the library overwrote it with <code>relative</code>. Re-init on the same elements is fine; exotic external mutation in between is not.</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Browser Support</h2><a id="user-content-browser-support" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Browser Support" href="#browser-support"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Requires WebGL 1.0 + Canvas 2D + SVG <code>foreignObject</code>. Effectively all evergreen browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge). WebGL context loss is recovered automatically.</p>
